rv.q: As an experience to just wash over you and let the moments that strike you strike you, The Kick Inside has its pleasures.
This is live theater at its absolute best.
The Kick Inside serves as a time capsule, catapulting its audiences back to the heyday of experimental theater.
The Kick Inside feels completely random; it has aliens, a talking canine, milkshakes, and innards.

cn.t: An experimental tribute to Kate Bush's album divides critics with its avant-garde vignettes—some praise its bold return to '60s-'70s theater aesthetics, while others find its abstract approach too random and impenetrable.
